hints.content: There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $x$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }x&=-10
\\\\
\text{larger }x&=-3
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(-\dfrac{13}{2},\dfrac{49}{4}\right)$

question.content:
$f(x)=-(x+3)(x+10)$

**1) What are the zeros of the function?**  
*Write the smaller $x$ first, and the larger $x$ second.*

$\text{smaller }x=$ [[☃ input-number 1]]

$\text{larger }x=$ [[☃ input-number 2]]

**2) What is the vertex of the parabola?**

$($[[☃ input-number 3]]$,$[[☃ input-number 4]]$)$
